name: Tutorial Summer
original_name: チュートリアルサマー
source:
Hyuuga Ippei is a self-supporting university student. He has to work part-time to finance his studies so he does not have spare time to spend for summer sports, Romance, refreshing summer retreat, not even summer festival.

"During this summer, I want you to tutor my granddaughters living in the countryside beach," his professor ask along with the promise of good salary and accommodation. It is also a good opportunity to enjoy summer, on top of that, those girls are known to be cute.

"I'll do tutoring! Please let me do it!"
translation:
日向一平是一名依靠自己维持学业的大学生。他必须打工赚取学费，因此根本没有闲暇享受夏季运动、恋爱、清爽的避暑旅行，甚至连夏日祭都无缘参加。

“今年夏天，我想请你去乡下海边，辅导我的孙女们。”教授向他提出请求，并承诺提供优厚薪水和住宿。这也是享受夏日的大好机会，更何况那些女孩都以可爱闻名。

“我愿意辅导！请务必让我去！”
